title: NTPC vs NTPC Green Energy: Decoding Q2 FY27 Performance
description: NTPC reported a robust 38.7% year-on-year profit growth, reaching ₹7,029.56 crore for Q2 FY27. Its subsidiary, NTPC Green Energy, also saw significant profit .

faq.q: What is the key difference in Q2 FY27 performance between NTPC and NTPC Green Energy?
faq.a: NTPC, the parent company, reported a larger absolute profit of ₹7,029.56 crore with 38.7% growth. NTPC Green Energy, its subsidiary, showed a higher percentage growth of 59%, reaching a profit of ₹137.50 crore.

faq.q: Did NTPC declare a dividend for Q2 FY27?
faq.a: Yes, NTPC announced its first interim dividend for investors for Q2 FY27. Details regarding the specific amount and record date are expected to be announced soon.

faq.q: Why is NTPC Green Energy's profit much lower than NTPC's, despite higher growth?
faq.a: NTPC Green Energy operates on a smaller base as a relatively newer entity focused on renewable projects. NTPC, being an established power giant, has a much larger operational scale and asset base from conventional power generation.

faq.q: What drives the growth of NTPC Green Energy?
faq.a: NTPC Green Energy's growth is primarily driven by increasing investments in solar and wind projects, favourable government policies promoting renewable energy, and the rising demand for sustainable power solutions.

faq.q: How do these results impact long-term investors in NTPC?
faq.a: For long-term investors, NTPC's strong profit growth and dividend declaration signal stability and consistent returns. The robust performance of its green energy arm also indicates a positive strategic direction for future growth and sustainability.
